title: Custom TCP service
description: Define a custom TCP service on 8081, allow only that service, and explicitly deny ordinary HTTP.
task_prompt: Repair the custom TCP service so the scoped API rule allows TCP/8081 and still explicitly denies HTTP.
help: Required service: LAB-API-TCP must use tcp-portrange 8081. Keep the exercise within the FortiOS trial limit of three firewall policies.

cases.description: The custom service must allow TCP/8081.
The same API object must explicitly deny TCP/80.

flows.description: The repaired service must not grant the starter's old TCP/8080 port.
The custom service must not silently widen to TCP/8082.
The custom API rule remains scoped to the named LAN client.
